---
applyTo: "src/main/resources/application.properties"
---

# Application configuration (`application.properties`)

- Properties format only (no YAML); keep Italian comments, as in the existing file.
- The database is in-memory H2 (`jdbc:h2:mem:magazzino;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1`) and the schema is generated by Hibernate (`ddl-auto=create-drop`). Don't add Flyway/Liquibase, SQL scripts or a persistent/external datasource unless explicitly requested; seed data lives in `config/DatiIniziali`, not in `data.sql`.
- Keep `spring.jpa.open-in-view=false`. Templates must not rely on lazy loading; fetch what a page needs in the service.
- `spring.thymeleaf.cache=false` is a development setting so pages reload without restart; don't remove it.
- Spring Boot 4: verify property names against the Boot 4.1 reference before adding them; don't assume Boot 3 names still apply.
- Don't put secrets or environment-specific values here.
- After changes, run `.\mvnw.cmd test`: every `@SpringBootTest` loads this file.
